stories.title: Hidden Gas Risks Inside Your Home
stories.description: Overlooked gas-related hazards in homes that can silently become dangerous if ignored.

scenes.visual_prompt: A slow cinematic pan across a modern kitchen and living area at dawn. Soft daylight enters through windows, curtains gently sway, appliances sit quietly. The camera glides smoothly, creating a calm and trustworthy atmosphere.
scenes.visual_reference: A clean modern home interior with gas appliances.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, fire, smoke, dark, scary
scenes.narration: Gas-powered homes feel comfortable and efficient, but some risks remain completely invisible.

scenes.visual_prompt: A slow push-in shot toward a gas stove connection behind the appliance. The camera focuses on metal pipes and valves, with subtle ambient vibration and shallow depth of field.
scenes.visual_reference: Gas pipe connection behind a kitchen stove.
scenes.narration: Loose fittings, aging pipes, or worn seals can slowly release gas without any visible warning.

scenes.visual_prompt: The camera tilts upward from a gas heater toward a partially blocked ventilation opening. Warm air subtly distorts the background, and dust particles float gently in the light.
scenes.visual_reference: Indoor gas heater with ventilation opening above.
scenes.narration: Poor ventilation can allow dangerous gases to build up indoors, especially during colder months.

scenes.visual_prompt: A slow orbit shot around a quiet hallway where a carbon monoxide detector is mounted. The camera circles gently as a small indicator light blinks steadily.
scenes.visual_reference: Carbon monoxide detector installed on a hallway wall.
scenes.narration: Headaches, dizziness, or fatigue are often ignored signs of gas exposure inside the home.

scenes.visual_prompt: A close-up shot of a hand pressing the test button on a carbon monoxide detector. The camera holds steady, with a slight handheld realism as the indicator responds.
scenes.visual_reference: A person testing a carbon monoxide alarm.
scenes.narration: Regular testing of gas and carbon monoxide detectors helps catch problems before they become emergencies.

scenes.visual_prompt: A wide dolly-out shot revealing a well-ventilated, organized home with windows slightly open and appliances neatly maintained. Soft afternoon light fills the space, creating a reassuring final mood.
scenes.visual_reference: A well-maintained home with proper ventilation and safety devices.
scenes.narration: Routine inspections and proper ventilation keep invisible gas risks from becoming real dangers.
